narration:0:16010572:0.text: Cyran kneels to examine the headmaster's body. Zorya approaches, and he rises to speak with her.
narration:0:16010572:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷蹲下检查校长遗体，此时佐尔娅靠近，迪尔格雷随即...

say:2:1610547501:1.text: Ah... Professor Zorya, my old mentor. Perfect timing.
say:2:1610547501:1.source_cn: 啊……佐尔娅女士，我旧日的恩师，你来得正好。

say:3:1610547502:1.text: I have many questions about what just happened. But above all, why has Headmaster Leymar ended up like this? Perhaps you can enlighten me?
say:3:1610547502:1.source_cn: 关于现在正发生的情况，我有很多疑问。但最大的问题是，雷...

say:4:1610547503:1.text: An investigation is already underway to determine exactly that. I have no answers yet.

say:5:1610547504:1.text: Excellent. Then let's see where this investigation takes us.
say:5:1610547504:1.source_cn: 真好，看来我们就这个问题达成一致了。

say:6:1610547505:1.text: Magic is a profound and mysterious thing. It can achieve wonders that ordinary people call impossible.
say:6:1610547505:1.source_cn: 魔法是一门深奥且奇妙的学问，它能做到许多普通人看来荒诞...

say:7:1610547506:1.text: It can turn falsehood into truth, or even bring the dead back to life... But, a disguise is still a disguise. It cracks eventually. Don't you agree, Professor Zorya?
say:7:1610547506:1.source_cn: 它能将假变成真，坏转为好，甚至将生死颠倒……但伪装就是...

say:8:1610547507:1.text: If you're talking about those who disguise their crimes, or villains posing as heroes, then yes. Their deceit always comes to light.
say:8:1610547507:1.source_cn: 如果你说的是那些伪装成无辜者的凶手，或是伪装成善良人的...

say:9:1610547508:1.text: But I remember teaching you this: not all disguises are born of malice. Motives and actions are two very different things.
say:9:1610547508:1.source_cn: 但我曾经教过你，“伪装”的目的并非都是邪恶的。动机与行...

say:10:1610547509:1.text: Of course, Professor. I remember your teachings well. Perhaps that lesson could use a refresher, though. Surely, over the years, you've seen disguises that weren't evil. Care to share a few examples with your old student?
say:10:1610547509:1.source_cn: 当然，老师，我记得很清楚。我想当年的课程可以加一点课时...

say:11:1610547510:1.text: I think it's better that you discover those on your own. That's the best way to learn a lesson. For now, I think we have more pressing matters to attend to.
say:11:1610547510:1.source_cn: 或许你以后会见识到，但不是现在。眼下我们还有更紧迫的事...

say:13:1610547511:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, Magister Cyran. We need your advice on the selection exam...
say:13:1610547511:1.source_cn: ——很抱歉打断你们的谈话，迪尔格雷大人。宫廷魔法师选拔...

say:14:1610547512:1.text: With such an incident, I suggest that the exam be suspended until the investigation is concluded.
say:14:1610547512:1.source_cn: 出现了这么严重的事故，选拔赛就先暂停吧。等什么时候我们...

say:15:1610547513:1.text: Of course, Magister Cyran. I will inform the students.
say:15:1610547513:1.source_cn: 好的，迪尔格雷大人。我会向大家宣布这个决定。

say:16:1610547514:1.text: Cyran casts a glance at Durella, then shifts his gaze toward the ground. Following his look, you see the Arcane Disruptor lying there.
say:16:1610547514:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷看了杜瑞拉一眼，然后又将目光转向另一边。你顺着...
say:16:1610547514:1.male: Cyran casts a glance at Durella, then shifts his gaze toward the ground. Following his look, you see the Arcane Disruptor lying there.
say:16:1610547514:1.female: Cyran casts a glance at Durella, then shifts his gaze toward the ground. Following his look, you see the Arcane Disruptor lying there.

say:17:1610547515:1.text: That device clearly played a key role in this incident. It interrupted the spell Zorya placed on the headmaster, revealing his true condition in front of everyone.
say:17:1610547515:1.source_cn: 校长死亡暴露的确与反魔法射线装置有着直接的联系——它阻...

say:19:1610547516:1.text: Did Silven really use it by coincidence, or did he know exactly what he was doing? And was that tense exchange between Cyran and Zorya connected to all this somehow? How about Cyran's signal to Durella...?
say:19:1610547516:1.source_cn: 休选择使用反魔法射线装置来阻止莱希拉姆守卫，他的行动真...

say:20:1610547517:1.text: You feel yourself lost in a fog of mysteries. Perhaps you should examine the <style="highlight">small Arcane Disruptor</style> yourself...
